title.en: Both, neither, each, all of them

goal.sl: Rabiš both, either, neither za dva ter each, every, all, none za več, s parno besedo (both … and, neither … nor) in s pravim glagolom.
goal.de: Du nimmst both, either, neither für zwei und each, every, all, none für mehr, mit den Paaren (both … and, neither … nor) und dem richtigen Verb.
goal.it: Usi both, either, neither per due ed each, every, all, none per di più, con le coppie (both … and, neither … nor) e il verbo giusto.
goal.en: You can use both, either, neither for two, and each, every, all, none for more, with the pairs (both … and, neither … nor) and the right verb.

say.sl: **both** je za dva, oba da: **Both dogs are asleep.** (Oba psa spita.) Pred zaimkom vedno **of**: **Both of them are asleep.**, **both of us**. Za be, pred drugim glagolom: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** Ljudje rečejo tudi *the both of them*; pisava hoče **both of them**. Slovenščina ima tu dvojino.
say.de: **both** ist für zwei, beide ja: **Both dogs are asleep.** (Beide Hunde schlafen.) Vor einem Pronomen immer **of**: **Both of them are asleep.**, **both of us**. Nach be, vor anderen Verben: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** Man sagt auch *the both of them*; geschrieben steht **both of them**.
say.it: **both** è per due, tutti e due sì: **Both dogs are asleep.** (Tutti e due i cani dormono.) Davanti a un pronome sempre **of**: **Both of them are asleep.**, **both of us**. Dopo be, prima di altri verbi: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** Si dice anche *the both of them*; per iscritto si usa **both of them**.
say.en: **both** is for two, yes to both: **Both dogs are asleep.** Before a pronoun always **of**: **Both of them are asleep.**, **both of us**. After be, before other verbs: **They are both tired.** **They both live here.** People also say *the both of them*; writing wants **both of them**.

examples.it: Tutti e due i cani dormono.

say.sl: **neither** je ne eden ne drugi, **either** eden ali drugi, vseeno kateri: **Neither of them is here.** (Nobeden od njiju ni tukaj.) **Either of them will do.** Glagol je pozitiven; v govoru tudi **Neither of them are here.** Z not je **either**: **I don't like either of them.** Ljudje rečejo tudi *I don't like neither of them*; pisava hoče **either**.
say.de: **neither** ist keiner von beiden, **either** einer von beiden, egal welcher: **Neither of them is here.** (Keiner von beiden ist hier.) **Either of them will do.** Das Verb ist bejaht; gesprochen auch **Neither of them are here.** Mit not steht **either**: **I don't like either of them.** Man sagt auch *I don't like neither of them*; geschrieben steht **either**.
say.it: **neither** è nessuno dei due, **either** l'uno o l'altro, non importa quale: **Neither of them is here.** (Nessuno dei due è qui.) **Either of them will do.** Il verbo è positivo; a voce anche **Neither of them are here.** Con not si usa **either**: **I don't like either of them.** Si dice anche *I don't like neither of them*; per iscritto si usa **either**.
say.en: **neither** is not one and not the other, **either** one or the other, it doesn't matter which: **Neither of them is here.** **Either of them will do.** The verb says yes; in talk also **Neither of them are here.** With not it's **either**: **I don't like either of them.** People also say *I don't like neither of them*; writing wants **either**.

say.sl: Pari povezujejo dve stvari: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Both Jack and Sam are coming.** **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** (Ne Jack ne Sam ne prideta.) **You can either walk or take the bus.** Slovenščina ima več ne, angleščina enega. Ljudje rečejo tudi *neither Jack or Sam*; pisava hoče **nor**.
say.de: Paare verbinden zwei Dinge: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Both Jack and Sam are coming.** **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** (Weder Jack noch Sam kommt.) **You can either walk or take the bus.** Es gibt nur ein Nein. Man sagt auch *neither Jack or Sam*; geschrieben steht **nor**.
say.it: Le coppie uniscono due cose: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Both Jack and Sam are coming.** **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** (Né Jack né Sam vengono.) **You can either walk or take the bus.** C'è un solo no. Si dice anche *neither Jack or Sam*; per iscritto si usa **nor**.
say.en: Pairs join two things: **both … and**, **neither … nor**, **either … or**: **Both Jack and Sam are coming.** **Neither Jack nor Sam is coming.** **You can either walk or take the bus.** There's only one no. People also say *neither Jack or Sam*; writing wants **nor**.

say.sl: **every** gleda vse skupaj, **each** vsakega posebej; oba hočeta ednino: **Every sheep has a mark.** (Vsaka ovca ima znamenje.) **Each sheep has its own mark.** **each** je tudi za dva: **She had a bag in each hand.** Z of: **each of them**, **every one of them** (never *every of them*). V govoru tudi **Each of them have a mark.**
say.de: **every** sieht alle zusammen, **each** jeden einzeln; beide wollen die Einzahl: **Every sheep has a mark.** (Jedes Schaf hat ein Zeichen.) **Each sheep has its own mark.** **each** geht auch für zwei: **She had a bag in each hand.** Mit of: **each of them**, **every one of them** (never *every of them*). Gesprochen auch **Each of them have a mark.**
say.it: **every** guarda tutti insieme, **each** uno per uno; tutti e due vogliono il singolare: **Every sheep has a mark.** (Ogni pecora ha un segno.) **Each sheep has its own mark.** **each** va anche per due: **She had a bag in each hand.** Con of: **each of them**, **every one of them** (never *every of them*). A voce anche **Each of them have a mark.**
say.en: **every** looks at all of them together, **each** at one by one; both want the singular: **Every sheep has a mark.** **Each sheep has its own mark.** **each** works for two as well: **She had a bag in each hand.** With of: **each of them**, **every one of them** (never *every of them*). In talk also **Each of them have a mark.**

say.sl: **all** so vsi, **none** nobeden, oboje za več kot dva: **All the sheep are on the fell.** **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** (Nobeden ni prišel.) **none** je že ne, zato brez not. **None of them is** ali **are**, oboje je prav. Ljudje rečejo tudi *I haven't got none*; pisava hoče **any**.
say.de: **all** sind alle, **none** keiner, beides für mehr als zwei: **All the sheep are on the fell.** **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** (Keiner ist gekommen.) **none** ist schon nein, also ohne not. **None of them is** oder **are**, beides stimmt. Man sagt auch *I haven't got none*; geschrieben steht **any**.
say.it: **all** sono tutti, **none** nessuno, per più di due: **All the sheep are on the fell.** **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** (Non è venuto nessuno.) **none** è già no, quindi senza not, anche se l'italiano ha *non*. **None of them is** o **are**, vanno bene tutti e due. Si dice anche *I haven't got none*; per iscritto si usa **any**.
say.en: **all** is all of them, **none** not one, both for more than two: **All the sheep are on the fell.** **All of them are on the fell.** **None of them came.** **none** is already no, so there's no not. **None of them is** or **are**, both are right. People also say *I haven't got none*; writing wants **any**.

say.sl: Še druge besede gredo pred **of them**, kot **some** in **any**: **Most of them are Herdwicks.** (Večina je pasme herdwick.) **Some of them are lost.** **One of them is lame.** **Have you seen any of them?** Pred zaimkom je **of** nujen. **Not all of them came.** pove, da nekateri niso.
say.de: Auch andere Wörter stehen vor **of them**, wie **some** und **any**: **Most of them are Herdwicks.** (Die meisten sind Herdwicks.) **Some of them are lost.** **One of them is lame.** **Have you seen any of them?** Vor dem Pronomen muss **of** stehen. **Not all of them came.** sagt, dass manche nicht kamen.
say.it: Anche altre parole stanno davanti a **of them**, come **some** e **any**: **Most of them are Herdwicks.** (La maggior parte sono Herdwick.) **Some of them are lost.** **One of them is lame.** **Have you seen any of them?** Davanti al pronome **of** ci vuole. **Not all of them came.** dice che alcuni non sono venuti.
say.en: Other words go before **of them** too, like **some** and **any**: **Most of them are Herdwicks.** **Some of them are lost.** **One of them is lame.** **Have you seen any of them?** Before a pronoun **of** has to be there. **Not all of them came.** says some didn't.

title.it: I figli e le pecore di Mr Tyson

exercises.text: Mr Tyson has two sons, and ___ of them live in Kendal. ___ of them wants the mill, so it's for sale. He has fifty sheep, and ___ sheep has a mark. ___ of them are on the fell today. ___ of them have got lost this year, which makes him happy. You can buy ___ a lamb or a sack of oats from him. He's ___ rich nor poor.

accept: both
Neither
every
each
All
Most
Some
Many
None
either
neither

translation.sl: Gospod Tyson ima dva sinova, oba živita v Kendalu. Nobeden od njiju noče mlina, zato je naprodaj. Ima petdeset ovc in vsaka ovca ima znamenje. Vse so danes na hribu. Nobena se letos ni izgubila, zato je vesel. Pri njem lahko kupiš jagnje ali vrečo ovsa. Ni ne bogat ne reven.
translation.de: Mr Tyson hat zwei Söhne, und beide wohnen in Kendal. Keiner von beiden will die Mühle, darum steht sie zum Verkauf. Er hat fünfzig Schafe, und jedes Schaf hat ein Zeichen. Alle sind heute auf dem Fell. Keines hat sich heuer verirrt, was ihn freut. Du kannst bei ihm entweder ein Lamm oder einen Sack Hafer kaufen. Er ist weder reich noch arm.
translation.it: Mr Tyson ha due figli, che abitano tutti e due a Kendal. Nessuno dei due vuole il mulino, quindi è in vendita. Ha cinquanta pecore, e ogni pecora ha un segno. Oggi sono tutte sul fell. Quest'anno non se n'è persa nessuna, il che lo rende felice. Da lui puoi comprare un agnello o un sacco d'avena. Non è né ricco né povero.
translation.en: Mr Tyson has two sons, and both of them live in Kendal. Neither of them wants the mill, so it's for sale. He has fifty sheep, and every sheep has a mark. All of them are on the fell today. None of them have got lost this year, which makes him happy. You can buy either a lamb or a sack of oats from him. He's neither rich nor poor.
